customer_persona: Everyday compact-SUV buyers comparing engine and gearbox choices, passenger and luggage space, useful equipment and ownership costs. Their actual route, household, location, budget and preferred trim remain unknown unless they choose to share them.
decision_frame: The strongest fit is the engine and trim whose gearbox, seating and equipment match what you need, and the thing still to verify is that exact version’s current on-road quote.
takeaway: Choose an offered engine-and-gearbox combination, then confirm the equipment and current quote for its exact trim.
primary_outcome: Identify an offered CRETA engine, gearbox and trim combination to check against the buyer’s needs.
supporting_outcomes: Understand how the supported seating and cabin functions fit possible use.
Separate confirmed equipment from the price, policy and measured evidence still needed.

concerns.why: Manual and automatic availability changes with both engine and trim, even where trim names are similar.
Split-seat flexibility does not establish personal passenger, luggage or parking fit.
Standard airbags and selected-trim driving assistance establish equipment, not a crash-test score.
The dated conflicting entry amount is not a current local on-road quote and extended petrol warranty costs extra.
Measured fuel use, service costs and resale evidence are not supplied.

intake.q1: Hi, welcome to the Hyundai CRETA; would you like to share what you’re looking for in your next car, or shall we get started?

do_not_recommend_if: Do not recommend a specific version while a non-negotiable requirement depends on missing fuel-economy, safety-test, personal-fit, price or availability evidence.
advance: When the buyer wants to verify a version, offer Request dealer contact so the selected Hyundai dealer can confirm the chosen engine, gearbox and trim and provide a current itemised on-road quotation; the app records the contact preference and optional follow-up, not completed contact or booking.
notes: Explore overview: reserve F015/F016, 23 words, on im_pdf_e1266b7974b364c1c1ba only, explaining stationary holding without the brake remaining pressed and standard fit from King, then hand off the non-turbo petrol engine. Do not repeat auto hold in guided proof; the Browse intro/outcome are alternative opening material. Guided main allocation is 427 words in 14 batches: powertrain 31+32+31; wheels 28; split seat 32; safety 31+31; cabin 31+31; delighters 30+30; price 30; supplemental storage 27; establish 32. Add 23 overview and 45 closing words for the full 495-word target. Each main batch has one pictured subject; ownership uses explicitly contextual single frames and records missing literal documents. Rear recline and Bose sound stay deeper rather than being appended to a different subject’s batch. Space totals two main batches including storage, ownership two including establish, other stops at most two and powertrain three. Only the final supported-fit statement and next-action statement use the 45-word closing; all segment checkins remain empty. The seven Coach stops and three USP objects are unchanged; no version ID was provided. Exact engine matrix for deeper/Q&A: F065 non-turbo petrol manual = E, EX, EX(O), S(O), S(O) Knight, SX, SX Premium, King; F066 non-turbo petrol automatic = EX(O), S(O), SX Premium, King, King Knight, Lounge Edition; F067 diesel manual = E, EX, EX(O), S(O), S(O) Knight, SX Premium, King; F068 diesel automatic = EX(O), S(O), King, King Knight, Lounge Edition; F006 turbo automatic = King only, and King also has other engines. These are the compiled 19 September 2026 offerings, not live stock, and their gaps must never become a from-trim continuous run. The table also shows no currently offered automatic S(O) Knight combination despite the starred equipment rows; preserve both facts without inventing one. Complete technical quantities, period/eligibility/policy terms and the conflicting dated entry prices stay in deeper. Resolve image links by literal descriptions rather than fact-level suggestions: phone charging is not mirroring, a camera display is not a sensor, front storage is not a rear armrest, and a rear table is not recline operation. The configured Sarvam Priya identity is retained; no buyer-specific preference is invented and no CTA destination is fabricated.
